newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Burlington Northern raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Burlington Northern raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it raised its rating for Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp to outperform from outperform (speculative) because the shares appear to be oversold by institutions.
-- Gruntal said the rail company's P/E based on Gruntal's earnings estimate of $6.60 a share is 10.9 times the amount for 1997 and 9.2 times the prospective earnings for 1998.
-- A more appropriate P/E for Burlington Northern might be 12 to 13 times 1997 estimates and 11 to 12 times 1998 projections, Gruntal said.
-- Burlington Northern is a railroad operating company.
-- Its shares were off 1-1/4 Friday at 71-1/2.
